compound-interest.keyword: Compound interest calculator with monthly contributions
compound-interest.description: Project fixed monthly deposits using a nominal annual rate compounded monthly. Compare your contributions with modeled earnings; use the complete examples below to change timing or inflation.
Use daily compounding with monthly deposits. This example keeps the same nominal rate and deposit schedule as the monthly case; daily compounding does not add daily contributions.
Convert a 5% nominal rate compounded monthly to an equivalent annual rate while preserving effective yield. Changing the quote is different from holding a nominal rate fixed.

boat-loan.description: Calculate the monthly payment from purchase price, cash down payment, trade value and entered tax and fees. Compare total loan interest and upfront cash; ownership expenses are separate.
aliases: Boat loan calculator with down payment

boat-loan.keyword: Boat price from a monthly loan budget
boat-loan.description: Work backward from a $700 monthly loan-payment budget. The result is a modeled purchase price under the complete entered assumptions, with operating and storage expenses budgeted separately.

savings.description: Project your ending balance from starting savings and deposits. Monthly and annual deposits can increase each year; separate contributions, earnings and purchasing power.
Keep your target and deadline fixed to solve the monthly deposit. This example starts with $2,000 and targets $20,000 in five years at an assumed constant 4% APY.
Keep monthly deposits fixed and find the first whole month reaching the target. This restores the $2,000 start, $20,000 goal, $300 monthly deposits and 4% APY example.
Enter an APY quote as APY, rather than dividing it by twelve as a nominal rate. This hypothetical 4% APY example fetches no current bank rates; the compounding selector is ignored for APY.

mortgage.keyword: Mortgage calculator with taxes and insurance
mortgage.description: Estimate principal and interest alongside property tax, homeowners insurance and other entered ownership costs. These costs can change independently of the loan payment.

Start from a $320,000 loan balance and entered remaining term rather than reverse a purchase price. The $400,000 original property value supports percentage-cost and PMI assumptions; taxes and insurance remain separate.

Load the hypothetical $375,000 purchase with 10% down and explicitly entered $1,500 annual PMI. Compare principal and interest, PMI and complete monthly housing costs. This is a manual illustration, not a lender PMI quote.

401k.description: Project annual account growth with salary increases, employee contributions and employer matching under the documented annual limits.

Review a hypothetical 6% employee contribution on $80,000 pay, separately from a 50%-of-first-6% employer match and the existing balance. Projection assumptions are constant planning inputs, not payroll or after-tax estimates.
Explore matching tiers using the Maximize Employer Match form. Eligibility and plan-specific rules must be checked separately.
Estimate the net amount after entered income-tax rates and any modeled 10% early-distribution tax. Selected qualifying exceptions waive the additional tax, not ordinary income tax.
Estimate the income-tax saving and paycheck effect of traditional and Roth employee deferrals under 2026 limits.

balance-transfer.description: Compare transfer fees, promotional APR, remaining balances and total borrowing costs under the same monthly payment.
Compare two transfer offers with the same balance and repayment budget.

cd.keyword: CD interest calculator with monthly compounding
cd.description: Load a twelve-month illustration using a 4% nominal annual rate compounded monthly. Its schedule shows accrued interest retained in the CD, not cash paid out monthly.
Load one $10,000 deposit for 6 months at an illustrative 4% APY, with zero modeled tax. APY already includes compounding; no current bank quote is retrieved.
Load one $10,000 deposit for 12 months at an illustrative 4% APY, with zero modeled tax. APY already includes compounding; no current bank quote is retrieved.
Load one $10,000 deposit for 14 months at an illustrative 4% APY, with zero modeled tax. APY already includes compounding; no current bank quote is retrieved.

mutual-fund.description: Project monthly contributions after an entry load, annual operating expense and final-balance exit charge. The default example uses a gross return before these charges.

mutual-fund.keyword: Mutual fund calculator without a sales load
mutual-fund.description: Remove the entry sales load while retaining the hypothetical 1% annual operating expense. No sales load does not mean no ongoing expenses.

investment-fee.description: Estimate the long-term effect of fund expense ratios and advisor fees using a transparent annual model. Compare amounts paid as fees with the balance reduction that also reflects lost growth, without deducting fund fees twice.

Estimate the long-term effect of fund expense ratios and advisor fees using a transparent annual model. Compare amounts paid as fees with the balance reduction that also reflects lost growth, without deducting fund fees twice.

Estimate the long-term effect of fund expense ratios and advisor fees using a transparent annual model. Compare amounts paid as fees with the balance reduction that also reflects lost growth, without deducting fund fees twice.
Estimate a separate 1% annual advisor charge with no additional fund expense in this example. Match the return basis and your actual contract; tiered and flat fees are not inferred.

auto-loan.description: Calculate a car loan payment with the stated manual tax, down payment and financed fees. Ownership expenses remain separate.
aliases: Auto loan calculator with taxes and fees

auto-loan.keyword: Auto loan calculator with trade in
auto-loan.description: Keep trade-in value separate from its unpaid loan. This manual example rolls $3,000 negative equity into financing; tax treatment is an entered assumption.
aliases: Auto loan calculator with trade in and sales tax

auto-loan.keyword: Car affordability calculator by monthly payment
auto-loan.description: Solve vehicle price from a $600 monthly loan budget, fixed term, down payment and manual taxes and fees. This does not budget insurance, fuel or maintenance.

personal-loan.keyword: Personal loan calculator with origination fee
personal-loan.description: Estimate payments, net initial cash and a modeled cash-flow APR with the fee deducted. Actual disclosures and fee classification require separate checks.

personal-loan.keyword: Personal loan calculator with financed fees
personal-loan.description: Finance the entered fee into the repayment balance. Compare net cash received as well as monthly installments; fee treatments do not all supply the same net cash.
Add an entered $20 per-payment insurance charge to the deducted-fee example. The payment including insurance differs from the principal-and-interest schedule.

student-loan.description: Estimate fixed monthly student loan payments and interest from an entered balance, rate and term. Daily accrual, income-driven plans and forgiveness are not calculated.
Estimate the effect of extra monthly, annual or one-time student-loan payments. This is a fixed-rate repayment model, not an income-driven repayment or forgiveness estimate.

student-loan.keyword: Student loan calculator with annual extra payments
student-loan.description: Keep the ten-year contractual installment and add $1,200 in month 12 and each year afterward. Annual timing differs from $100 extra every month.
